story.titleZh: 对手反驳阿隆索称F1车手水平低
story.summaryZh: 阿隆索在美国大奖赛后称车队后段车手水平“非常低”，并在墨西哥重申这一说法，但阿尔本等对手并不认同。
story.originalTitle: Rivals reject Alonso's brutal 'low quality' F1 drivers claim
story.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso claimed after the United States Grand Prix that the quality of drivers in the lower third of the field is "very low", and he doubled down on those remarks in Mexico, but rivals such as Alex Albon disagreed with him.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索的F1对手们反驳了这位西班牙车手关于车队后段车手水平“非常低”的说法。
这位阿斯顿·马丁车手是在美国大奖赛后发表上述言论的，此前他在第一圈与亚历克斯·阿尔本发生碰撞，导致赛车受损，并错失了拿分的机会。
周四在墨西哥的F1围场里，阿隆索的不满依然明显，他重申了自己的说法，但其他车手并不认同他关于水平不足的观点。
阿尔本正是阿隆索批评的对象，阿隆索认为正是阿尔本那次激进的举动引发了碰撞，但阿尔本认为自己并没有特别做错什么，也不觉得水平有所欠缺。
“我认为那是一场精彩的较量，”阿尔本谈到他与阿隆索的对抗时说道。“我觉得我们之间有一场很好的缠斗。
“显然他并不这么认为。但那是一场持续整场比赛的较量。即便是那个时刻的事件本身，我认为就赛车在赛道上的位置而言，那是相当五五开的情况。”
当被问及阿隆索加倍强调其言论——即F1在部分排名靠后车手的驾驶方式上存在问题——时，阿尔本坚持了自己的立场。
“我的意思是，我也会加倍坚持我所说的话，”他说。“我对费尔南多怀有极大的敬意。我小时候非常仰慕他，显然在很多方面听到那些评论并不好受。你正在与你所仰慕的人比赛。
“但与此同时，我并不同意。就这么简单。我认为整个发车格上下水平的强度都很高。
“我认为10到15年前，发车格后半段并不是现在这样。我们不再有付费车手了。所以是的，就是这样。希望这个周末的比赛中我们不会在弯角或路线上相遇。
周四，阿隆索被追问他在奥斯汀赛后发表的言论，他强调自己关于发车格后三分之一车手的评论并不是要单独针对某个具体数量的车手。
但他坚称，他认为有些车手在F1中表现出的水平没有达到必要标准。
“我并没有具体说有多少人，但我想我们都知道我们说的是哪些人，以及哪些人觉得那条评论冒犯了自己，”他说。“所以这就说明了一切。”
“所以我仍然有同样的感觉。那是一个不必要的错误。我仍然难以理解的是，阿历克斯在那个时刻看到了什么机会。”
“但不只是奥斯汀。不幸的是，整个赛季我都处在比赛的的那个位置，所以我从车里看到了一些我无能为力的事情。”
阿隆索承认，驾驶竞争力较弱的赛车比在前排更困难，但他认为这不是驾驶不佳的借口。
他补充道：“他们的抓地力更少，所以失误出现得更频繁，因为你没有那种处于掌控之中的环境。赛车不会以友好的方式迎接你。所以你会犯更多错误。”
“但我并不觉得第一圈的所有事故、所有碰撞、所有飞来飞去的前翼——所有这些事情都是必要的。”
“尤其是当你在队尾毫无意义地缠斗时，还有预算帽，也让这个问题雪上加霜。但你知道，如果他们的车队对每场比赛都撞坏东西还要遵守预算帽感到满意，那对他们来说也没问题。”
阿尔本并不是唯一一位不同意阿隆索对当前F1发车阵容下游车手能力水平评价的车手。
法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔表示，即使对于那些难以取得好成绩的车手来说，车手水平也“非常高”。
提到阿尔本时，勒克莱尔说他“非常出色”，并指出还有其他车手“在整个青训生涯中都表现突出”。
他补充道：“我确信发车区的水平超级、超级高，无论是在后排、中游还是前排。唯一明显变化的是我们驾驶的赛车，但标准非常高。”
阿尔派 的皮埃尔·加斯利今年尽管有一些亮眼表现，但仍有在车阵中比赛的经验，他觉得与几年前相比，情况有了很大改善。
加斯利说：“你不得不喜欢费尔南多在外面发表的那些言论，我非常尊重他作为一名车手的身份，同时他也非常直言不讳。”
“我没有看他的比赛，也不太确定他指的是什么，但我要说的是，考虑到我们现在拥有的所有车手，发车区上的水平大概是最高的之一。
“从我看到的来看，大概有九年了，与我刚加入时相比，我见过一些更狂野的驾驶方式。”
哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼认为，车队后段之所以如此紧张，只是因为竞争太激烈，不能错过取得好成绩的机会。
“我认为这个结论有点苛刻，因为我同意皮埃尔的看法，当前这个参赛阵容的水平非常高，”他针对阿隆索的说法表示。
“考虑到我们今年面临的差距，有时候你必须非常善于抓住机会，而这可能以灾难收场，就像上周我和皮埃尔那样。”
“我不会说这是实力问题。这是竭尽全力、试图有所作为的问题，当前八名几乎都被四大车队占据时，这非常具有挑战性。”
塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯认为，领先集团身后的竞争之所以更加疯狂，纯粹是因为赛车竞争力不足。
“当然，我认为后段的水平跟前面一样高，”他说。“我觉得如果我们跟前面那些人换车，我们会取得非常相似的成绩，或者反过来也一样。
“这就是一级方程式唯一的问题。你的水平取决于你的车和你的团队，所以我认为水平真的很高。而且当你看看后段那些名字时，那真的真的很高。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso’s Formula 1 rivals have pushed back against the Spaniard’s claims that the quality of drivers in the lower third of the field is “very low”.
The Aston Martin driver spoke out after the United States Grand Prix following a first corner clash with Alex Albon that damaged his car and cost him the opportunity to take points.
Alonso's annoyance was still clear in the F1 paddock on Thursday in Mexico, as he doubled down on his remarks, but other drivers did not concur with his view that standards were lacking.
Albon himself, who was in Alonso’s crosshairs for the aggressive move that triggered their collision, saw nothing especially wrong with what he did nor felt that quality was missing.
“I thought it was a good battle,” Albon said of his fight with Alonso. “I thought we had a good scrap.
“Clearly he didn't think the same thing. But it was a race long battle. Even the incident in that point itself, I thought it was quite very 50/50 in terms of where the cars were on track.”
Asked about Alonso doubling down on his remarks that F1 had a problem with the approach of some drivers further down the order, Albon stood firm.

“I mean, I'll double down with what I said as well,” he said. “I have a huge respect for Fernando. I looked up to him a lot growing up as a kid, and obviously it's not nice to hear those comments in many ways. You're racing someone that you look up to.
“But at the same time, I don't agree. It's as simple as that. I think the level is strong up and down the grid.

“I think 10-15 years ago, the back half of the grid wasn't the way it is now. We don't have pay drivers anymore. So yeah, it is what it is. Hopefully, we don't cross corners or cross paths in the race this weekend.
Alonso was probed on his post-Austin remarks on Thursday as he emphasised that his comments about the lower third of the grid was not about singling out a specific number of drivers.
But he is adamant that there are drivers who he feels are not behaving at the level necessary in F1.
“I'm not specific on the number of them, but I think we all know which ones we talk about and which ones they felt hit by that comment,” he said. “So that tells you everything.
“So I still feel the same. It was a mistake that was not needed. What I still find difficult to understand is what was the opportunity that Alex saw in that moment.
“But it's not only Austin. I've been unfortunately in that part of the race for the whole season, so I see things from the car that I cannot help.”
Alonso accepted that racing with a less competitive car was more difficult than being at the front, but he felt that was not an excuse for poor driving.

“They have less grip, so mistakes are coming more often because you don't have the environment that is under control,” he added. “The car is not welcoming you in a nice way. So you make more mistakes.
“But I don't feel that all the incidents in lap one, all the touches, all the front wings that fly around - all these kinds of things are not necessary.

“Especially if you are fighting for nothing at the back of the grid, and there is the cost cap, also adding to this problem. But you know, if their teams are happy with the cost cap on breaking things every race, it's OK for them.”
Albon wasn't the only driver who disagreed with Alonso’s assessment about the level of ability in the lower reaches of the current F1 grid.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc said that the level of drivers was “very high” even for those struggling to deliver good results.
Referencing Albon, Leclerc said that he was “exceptional” and that there were other drivers who “have been standing out throughout all the junior careers.”

He added: “I'm sure that the level of the grid is super, super high, whether it's in the back, in the middle, or in the front. The only thing that changes is obviously the race car that we are driving, but the standards are very high.”
Alpine’s Pierre Gasly, who has experience of racing in the pack this year despite some standout performances, felt that things were much improved compared to a few years ago.
“You’ve gotta love Fernando for the statements he makes out there, and I have so much respect for the driver he is, and at the same time he's very vocal,” said Gasly.
“I haven't seen his race and I'm not too sure what he referred to, but I will say that the level on the grid is probably one of the highest, considering all the drivers we have now.
“From what I've seen, which is maybe like nine years, I've seen some wilder driving approaches when I joined compared to what I see now.”
Haas’s Ollie Bearman reckoned that things were only so fraught towards the back of the pack because it was so competitive and opportunities to do well could not be missed.
“I think that's a slightly harsh conclusion because I agree with Pierre that the level is very high on this current grid,” he said in reference to Alonso’s claims.
“I think with the gaps that we face this year, you have to be very opportunistic at times, and that can end in disaster, like it did for me last week with myself and Pierre.

“I wouldn't say it's a question of quality. It's a question of trying your very best and trying to make something happen, which is very challenging when the top eight positions are pretty much all filled by the top four teams.”
Sergio Perez reckoned that the racing was more frenetic in the group behind the leading pack purely because the cars were not as competitive.
“Of course, I think the level at the back is as high as in the front,” he said. “I think if we swap cars with the guys at the front, we will be having very similar results, or vice versa.
“This is the only issue with Formula 1. You are as good as your car and your team, so I think the level is really high. And when you look at the names that are at the back, it's really, really high.”
keyPointsZh: 阿隆索是在美国大奖赛第一圈与阿尔本发生碰撞、赛车受损并错失积分机会后发表上述言论的。
阿尔本表示他与阿隆索的缠斗很激烈，那次事故在他看来是五五开。
阿尔本称自己非常尊重阿隆索，但明确表示不同意他的说法。
keyPointsEn: Alonso made the remarks after a first-lap clash with Albon at the United States Grand Prix damaged his car and cost him the chance to score points.
Albon said his battle with Alonso was a good scrap and that the incident looked 50/50 to him.
Albon said he has huge respect for Alonso but made clear he does not agree with him.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
